$comment: Cross-language vocabulary and protocol strings for Odessy's execution provider layer.
This file holds NAMES and byte-exact protocol strings ONLY. It is deliberately NOT the
semantic definition of the provider layer. Provider behaviour, ABI-to-limitation mapping,
probe logic, selection policy, and per-provider guarantees belong in code and tests.
The Python implementation loads this file at runtime; the TypeScript implementation loads
it at runtime as well, and a parity test in each language asserts agreement.
